# f(2+t)-f(2-t) = 8t + 2bt = 0 for all t  =>  b = -4

        vals_example = {k: str(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    orders.add(tuple(k for k, _ in sorted(v.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])))

if len(orders) == 1:
    ans = ", ".join(next(iter(orders)))
